basics.name: Junteng Liu
basics.summary: First-year PhD candidate at HKUST NLP Group. Research interests include LLM Reasoning, Hallucination in VLMs, and LLM Truthfulness.

work.summary: Research internship focusing on large language models.
Research internship under the supervision of Zifei Shan.
Research internship under the supervision of Prof. Yu Cheng.
